observations: Photos show a full engine block with a transmission/transaxle bolted to it, standing upright on a workshop floor.
A metal tag reading '3.8L V6' is clearly visible and legible in photo 2, also visible in photo 0.
Background shows a parts yard with signage for Ford, GMC, Acadia, Chevrolet brands, indicating a general scrapyard/parts dealer, not a Jeep-specific shop.
Unit is heavily soiled with dirt, oil residue, and corrosion on many surfaces.
Wiring harness, hoses, and sensors are still attached but cut/dangling in places, consistent with a pulled take-off unit.
No VIN plate, casting number, or transmission ID tag is legible in any photo.
No shifter, clutch fork, bellhousing markings, or any gear-selector mechanism is visible to confirm 'manual' vs 'automatic'.
Pink/purple paint marks on the casing appear to be yard inventory marks, not damage indicators.
